source_to_guarantee_to_human_review_to_t.source_condition: generated judgment pack and specialist agent have no authority when proposed
source_to_guarantee_to_human_review_to_t.requirement_guarantee: L2 guarantees the pack/agent remains a proposal and cannot grant operation permission or completion authority to itself.
source_to_guarantee_to_human_review_to_t.human_confirmation: L11 normal example: inspect the actual operation result and confirm the proposal is bound to the declared ticket/revision/scope, and that no authority/completion decision is attributed to it.

source_to_guarantee_to_human_review_to_t.remaining_scope: proposal status does not imply adoption or operation success

source_to_guarantee_to_human_review_to_t.source_condition: bind generated pack/agent to source snapshot and digest; changes to scope, requirement, template, skill, model catalog, or allowlist make selected material stale
source_to_guarantee_to_human_review_to_t.requirement_guarantee: L2 guarantees relation to the selected operation inputs and that a changed selected input cannot be silently represented by the prior proposal as current; effect is limited to affected operation/scope.
source_to_guarantee_to_human_review_to_t.human_confirmation: L11 normal/error/unseen examples: compare selected inputs and generation context; when selected input changes, confirm prior result is not reused and the affected action/reason are visible; confirm unselected input changes do not spill into selected scope.

source_to_guarantee_to_human_review_to_t.remaining_scope: unknown selection/applicability remains unresolved; no broad invalidation from unrelated inputs

source_to_guarantee_to_human_review_to_t.source_condition: fail-close unaudited pack, unauthorized tool, self-verification, unbounded subagent generation, or completion authority outside workflow
source_to_guarantee_to_human_review_to_t.requirement_guarantee: L2 retains all five safety guarantees, constrains response to affected operation action, and requires a visible reason/unresolved condition; no blanket stop for unrelated operation.
source_to_guarantee_to_human_review_to_t.human_confirmation: L11 error example: give a result containing one such condition and inspect whether that action advanced, whether its reason is visible, and whether unrelated operations remained in their existing state.
source_to_guarantee_to_human_review_to_t.technical_handoff: Detailed independent negatives, actor/route tuples, tool/path controls, bounded team construction, guard ordering, exact fixture format and machine assertions remain in receipt 001; they serve as technical handoff and do not define a new internal contract in L2.
source_to_guarantee_to_human_review_to_t.remaining_scope: selected HR conditions only; no new authorization, approval, dispatch, or fixed numeric limit
